messages:
maria: Opening a small PR for an airgapped KMS key/cert import guide for Private installs. Branch: docs/airgap-kms-import. Need: brief checklist, SoftHSM lab example, vendor caveats (in-device keys vs import), atomic install pattern, and a tiny migration note for v1.2 -> v1.3. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512

devon: please include a minimal SoftHSM import example and an example systemd unit that runs an install script atomically. Also add a note about time sync (chrony) for cert validation.

maria: draft snippets below:
```bash
# generate CSR on node
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out node.key -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048
openssl req -new -key node.key -subj "/CN=kms-node.lab" -out node.csr
# offline sign on isolated host
openssl x509 -req -in node.csr -CA int_ca.pem -CAkey int_ca.key -CAcreateserial -out node.crt -days 825
# lab: SoftHSM import
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so --login --pin 1234 --write-object node.key --type privkey --label "kms-node"
```

harry: add atomic install notes: write to tmp, chmod 0600, chown redwood-kms, then mv to /etc/redwood-kms/ and restart agent. rollback: keep backups like node.key.bak and node.crt.bak.

security: ack pending small wording change: remove literal PINs from examples (replace with <PIN>), add audit bullet: record signer identity and transfer chain on USB in secure log.

docs-bot: run docs/lint and docs/linkcheck before merge.

maria: updated, pushed changes, added migration blurb: "v1.3 docs include airgapped import examples; backport on request." Waiting for @security ack. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
